Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q1 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of AVGO.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 1110 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q1 2019.
We delivered record revenue of $12.1 billion this quarter, representing 14% year-over-year growth.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 14% to 7% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. We are reaffirming our full-year guidance and raising our EPS outlook to $5.51 per share.
Second question - Analyst:
Can you clarify whether the margin expansion is sustainable into next year given rising input costs?
Revenue guidance of $12.1 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
